question: Where is the headquarters of SAARC Development Fund (SDF) established by SAARC nations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thimphu, Bhutan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The headquarters of the SAARC Development Fund (SDF) is located in Thimphu, Bhutan.
 
• SAARC Development Fund (SDF) was established by the member nations of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC).
 
• The SDF serves as the umbrella financial institution for SAARC projects and programs.
 
• The primary objective of SDF is to promote the welfare of the people of SAARC region, improve their quality of life, and accelerate economic growth, social progress, and poverty alleviation in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)**

 
 
• SAARC is a regional intergovernmental organization and geopolitical union of states in South Asia.
 
• Its member states include Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• SAARC was established on December 8, 1985, with the aim to promote economic and regional integration.
 
• The headquarters of SAARC is located in Kathmandu, Nepal.
 
 
 
• **SAARC Development Fund (SDF)**
 
 
• The SDF was officially launched during the 16th SAARC Summit held in Thimphu, Bhutan, in April 2010.
 
• The SDF operates through three funding windows: Social, Economic, and Infrastructure.
 
• The Social Window primarily focuses on poverty alleviation and social development projects.
 
• The Economic and Infrastructure Windows focus on projects aimed at enhancing economic integration and infrastructure development in the region.
 
 
 
• **Thimphu, Bhutan**
 
 
• Thimphu is the capital and largest city of Bhutan.
 
• It is situated in the western central part of Bhutan and has a population of approximately 114,551.
 
• The city is the political and economic center of Bhutan, home to the royal family, government offices, and the main economic institutions.
 
• Thimphu is known for its rich cultural heritage, scenic beauty, and as a hub for various international organizations and institutions.
